metadata.description: Maps 9 rasas (emotional essences) to recommended Melakarta ragas with therapeutic applications

rasas.name: Shringara
rasas.description: The rasa of romantic love, beauty, devotion, and aesthetic pleasure

primary_ragas.name: Kharaharapriya
primary_ragas.rationale: Versatile emotional raga, foundation for love and yearning

primary_ragas.name: Harikambhoji
primary_ragas.rationale: Joyful and celebratory, suitable for love's exuberance

primary_ragas.name: Mechakalyani
primary_ragas.rationale: Expansive beauty, devotional love at its peak

rasas.name: Hasya
rasas.description: The rasa of laughter, mirth, playfulness, and light-hearted joy

primary_ragas.name: Dheerasankarabharanam
primary_ragas.rationale: Bright major scale, naturally uplifting and joyful

primary_ragas.name: Hemavati
primary_ragas.rationale: Golden quality, warmth and humor

primary_ragas.name: Harikambhoji
primary_ragas.rationale: Playful Mixolydian feel, natural lightness

rasas.name: Karuna
rasas.description: The rasa of compassion, empathy, tenderness, and gentle sorrow
rasas.therapeutic_application: Emotional processing, grief work, compassion cultivation

primary_ragas.name: Natabhairavi
primary_ragas.rationale: Natural minor, deeply evocative of tender emotion

primary_ragas.name: Keeravani
primary_ragas.rationale: Harmonic minor, poignant beauty in sorrow

primary_ragas.name: Hanumatodi
primary_ragas.rationale: Phrygian gravity, profound depth of feeling

rasas.name: Raudra
rasas.description: The rasa of righteous anger, intensity, fierce determination
rasas.therapeutic_application: Boundary setting, energy mobilization, processing anger

primary_ragas.name: Shulini
primary_ragas.rationale: Trident-like intensity, fierce and cutting

primary_ragas.name: Kamavardhini
primary_ragas.rationale: Intensely passionate, drives transformative anger

primary_ragas.name: Suryakantam
primary_ragas.rationale: Solar intensity, blazing clarity

rasas.name: Veera
rasas.description: The rasa of heroism, valor, confidence, and determined action

primary_ragas.name: Simhendramadhyamam
primary_ragas.rationale: Lion-king raga, powerful and majestic

primary_ragas.name: Dharmavati
primary_ragas.rationale: Righteous action, dharmic courage

primary_ragas.name: Dheerasankarabharanam
primary_ragas.rationale: Courageous beauty in the major scale

rasas.name: Bhayanaka
rasas.description: The rasa of awe, wonder before the vast, confronting the unknown
rasas.therapeutic_application: Shadow work, facing fears, expanding comfort zone

primary_ragas.name: Jhalavarali
primary_ragas.rationale: Mysterious and rare, evokes confrontation with the unknown

primary_ragas.name: Shubhapantuvarali
primary_ragas.rationale: Deeply contemplative with an edge of awe

primary_ragas.name: Salagam
primary_ragas.rationale: First prati madhyama raga, threshold of transformation

rasas.name: Bibhatsa
rasas.description: The rasa of detachment, dispassion, vairagya — seeing through illusion
rasas.therapeutic_application: Detoxification, letting go, renunciation of harmful patterns

primary_ragas.name: Kanakangi
primary_ragas.rationale: Sparse and austere, strips away embellishment

primary_ragas.name: Salagam
primary_ragas.rationale: Ascetic quality, the beginning of prati madhyama austerity

primary_ragas.name: Latangi
primary_ragas.rationale: Subtle and creeping, reveals what is usually hidden

rasas.name: Adbhuta
rasas.description: The rasa of wonder, amazement, curiosity, and awe at creation

primary_ragas.name: Mayamalavagowla
primary_ragas.rationale: Raga of illusion (maya), wonder at creation's beauty

primary_ragas.name: Vachaspati
primary_ragas.rationale: Lord of speech, articulation of the marvelous

primary_ragas.name: Jyotiswarupini
primary_ragas.rationale: Light-formed, illumination and wonder

rasas.name: Shanta
rasas.description: The supreme rasa of peace, equanimity, and transcendent serenity. The goal of all other rasas.
rasas.therapeutic_application: Deep relaxation, meditation, spiritual practice, samadhi

primary_ragas.name: Dheerasankarabharanam
primary_ragas.rationale: Perfect balance of the major scale, supreme equanimity

primary_ragas.name: Mechakalyani
primary_ragas.rationale: Auspicious completeness, transcendent peace

primary_ragas.name: Kharaharapriya
primary_ragas.rationale: Versatile serenity, accepts all emotions equally
